               sjPlot, emmeans, broom, purrr, tibble, tidyr, rlang)

# 1) Paths & raw data load

```{r paths-and-load, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
# EDIT these if your paths differ
csv_path <- r"(D:/Dropbox/USD/Dissertation/Collab folder/Data/Dissertation+-+Study+2_September+30,+2025_19.12.csv)"
qsf_path <- r"(D:/Dropbox/USD/Dissertation/Collab folder/Data/Dissertation_-_Study_2.qsf)"
stopifnot(file.exists(csv_path), file.exists(qsf_path))

raw <- readr::read_csv(csv_path, skip = 1,
                       col_types = readr::cols(.default = readr::col_character()),
                       show_col_types = FALSE)

# drop the Qualtrics metadata row (ImportId)
dat <- raw %>%
  dplyr::filter(!dplyr::if_any(dplyr::everything(), ~ grepl("ImportId", .x, fixed = TRUE)))

dat = dat %>%
  filter(`Response Type` != "Survey Preview")

dat_orig <- dat
nrow(dat)
```

# 2) QSF → item metadata (Q1–Q20), positions per row

```{r qsf-to-positions, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
# ---- Read QSF ----
qsf <- jsonlite::fromJSON(qsf_path, simplifyVector = FALSE)
sq  <- Filter(function(el) identical(el$Element, "SQ"), qsf$SurveyElements)

get_tag   <- function(p) p$DataExportTag %||% NA_character_
get_qid   <- function(p) p$QuestionID    %||% NA_character_
get_text  <- function(p) p$QuestionText  %||% NA_character_
get_rand  <- function(p) { ra <- p$Randomization %||% list(); isTRUE(ra$Advanced) || isTRUE(ra$RandomizeAnswers) || !is.null(ra$Type) }
get_choice_order <- function(p) { ord <- p$ChoiceOrder %||% names(p$Choices); unname(as.character(ord)) }
get_choices_tbl <- function(p) {
  ch <- p$Choices %||% list()
  keys <- names(ch) %||% character(0)
  if (!length(keys)) return(tibble::tibble(key=character(0), text=character(0), recode=character(0)))
  rv <- p$RecodeValues %||% list()
  recode_vec <- vapply(keys, function(k) as.character(rv[[k]] %||% NA_character_), character(1))
  tibble::tibble(key = as.character(keys),
                 text = vapply(ch, function(x) x$Display %||% "", character(1)),
                 recode = recode_vec)
}

q_meta <- lapply(sq, function(el) {
  p <- el$Payload
  tibble::tibble(tag=get_tag(p), qid=get_qid(p), text=get_text(p), randomize=get_rand(p),
                 choice_order_default=list(get_choice_order(p)),
                 choices=list(get_choices_tbl(p)))
}) %>%
  dplyr::bind_rows() %>%
  dplyr::filter(!is.na(tag), grepl("^Q([1-9]|1[0-9]|20)$", tag)) %>%
  dplyr::arrange(factor(tag, levels = paste0("Q", 1:20)))

# ---- Match QSF text to CSV question columns ----
find_csv_col <- function(q_text, cols){
  m <- which(cols == q_text)[1]; if (!is.na(m)) return(cols[m])
  m <- which(startsWith(cols, q_text))[1]; if (!is.na(m)) return(cols[m])
  NA_character_
}
cols <- names(dat)
q_meta <- q_meta %>% dplyr::mutate(
  csv_col       = vapply(text, find_csv_col, character(1), cols = cols),
  csv_col_order = ifelse(is.na(csv_col), NA_character_, paste0(csv_col, " - Display Order"))
)

# ---- Helpers: normalize to choice KEYS; parse DO tokens ----
answer_to_key <- function(answer_val, choices){
  if (is.na(answer_val) || !length(choices$key)) return(NA_character_)
  ans <- as.character(answer_val)
  idx <- match(ans, choices$text);    if (!is.na(idx)) return(choices$key[idx])
  idx <- match(ans, choices$recode);  if (!is.na(idx)) return(choices$key[idx])
  lead <- stringr::str_extract(ans, "[0-9]+")
  if (!is.na(lead) && lead %in% choices$key) return(lead)
  if (ans %in% choices$key) return(ans)
  NA_character_
}

order_to_keys <- function(order_str, choices, default_keys){
  if (is.na(order_str) || !nzchar(order_str)) return(default_keys)
  # detect delimiter without escapes
  delim <- if (grepl("[|]", order_str)) "[|]" else if (grepl(";", order_str)) ";" else ","
  toks <- trimws(unlist(strsplit(order_str, delim)))
  if (!length(toks)) return(default_keys)
  if (all(toks %in% choices$key))  return(toks)
  if (all(toks %in% choices$text)) return(choices$key[match(toks, choices$text)])
  lead <- stringr::str_extract(toks, "[0-9]+")
  if (all(lead %in% choices$key))  return(lead)
  default_keys
}

# ---- Per‑QID positions, then coalesce to Q*_position ----
for (i in seq_len(nrow(q_meta))) {
  meta <- q_meta[i, ]
  qcol <- meta$csv_col
  if (is.na(qcol)) next
  odcol    <- meta$csv_col_order
  choices  <- meta$choices[[1]]
  def_keys <- meta$choice_order_default[[1]]
  qid      <- meta$qid
  tag      <- meta$tag
  pos_name <- paste0(tag, "_", qid, "_position")

  ans_keys <- vapply(dat[[qcol]], answer_to_key, character(1), choices = choices)

  ord_keys <- if (!is.na(odcol) && odcol %in% names(dat)) {
    lapply(dat[[odcol]], order_to_keys, choices = choices, default_keys = def_keys)
  } else {
    rep(list(def_keys), nrow(dat))
  }

  pos <- mapply(function(k, ord) {
    if (is.na(k) || !length(ord)) return(NA_integer_)
    p <- match(k, ord)
    if (is.na(p)) NA_integer_ else as.integer(p)
  }, ans_keys, ord_keys, SIMPLIFY = TRUE, USE.NAMES = FALSE)

  dat[[pos_name]] <- as.integer(pos)
}

# Coalesce all QID variants to a single tag-level column
tags <- unique(q_meta$tag)
for (tg in tags) {
  cols_tg <- grep(paste0("^", tg, "_.*_position$"), names(dat), value = TRUE)
  if (length(cols_tg)) {
    dat[[paste0(tg, "_position")]] <- purrr::reduce(dat[cols_tg], dplyr::coalesce) %>% as.integer()
  }
}

pos_cols_Q1_Q20 <- paste0("Q", 1:20, "_position")
pos_cols_Q1_Q20 <- pos_cols_Q1_Q20[pos_cols_Q1_Q20 %in% names(dat)]
length(pos_cols_Q1_Q20)
```

# 3) Attention filter (“Smart Home”)

```{r attention}
attn_col <- grep("^What type of dashboard did you see[?]?$", names(dat),
                 ignore.case = TRUE, value = TRUE)
if (length(attn_col) > 1) attn_col <- attn_col[1]

if (!length(attn_col)) {
  message("Attention question not found — keeping all rows.")
  dat_attn <- dat; dat_attn$exclude_reason <- NA_character_
} else {
  keep_idx <- grepl("smart[[:space:]]*home", dat[[attn_col]], ignore.case = TRUE)
  keep_idx[is.na(keep_idx)] <- FALSE
  dat$exclude_reason <- ifelse(keep_idx, NA_character_, "attention_fail")
  dat_attn <- dat[keep_idx, , drop = FALSE]
  message(sprintf("Attention filter kept %d / %d rows.", sum(keep_idx, na.rm = TRUE), nrow(dat)))
}

```

# 4) Longstring on positions (SurveyWave-aware: exclude Q3 for Waves 1–2)

```{r longstring, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
# find SurveyWave
wave_col <- grep("^[[:space:]]*survey[[:space:]]*wave[[:space:]]*$", names(dat_attn),
                 ignore.case = TRUE, value = TRUE)
wave_num <- if (length(wave_col) > 0) suppressWarnings(readr::parse_number(dat_attn[[wave_col[1]]])) else rep(NA_real_, nrow(dat_attn))


present_pos <- pos_cols_Q1_Q20[pos_cols_Q1_Q20 %in% names(dat_attn)]

q3_pos <- if ("Q3_position" %in% names(dat_attn)) "Q3_position" else {
  grep("^Q3(_.*)?_position$", names(dat_attn), value = TRUE)
}
q3_pos <- intersect(q3_pos, present_pos)

longest_run <- function(x) {
  x <- x[!is.na(x)]
  if (!length(x)) return(0L)
  r <- rle(x); max(r$lengths)
}

use_cols_by_row <- lapply(seq_len(nrow(dat_attn)), function(i) {
  cols <- present_pos
  if (length(q3_pos) && !is.na(wave_num[i]) && wave_num[i] %in% c(1, 2)) {
    cols <- setdiff(cols, q3_pos)
  }
  cols
})

ls_run <- vapply(seq_along(use_cols_by_row), function(i) {
  cols <- use_cols_by_row[[i]]
  if (!length(cols)) return(0L)
  v <- as.integer(dat_attn[i, cols, drop = FALSE])
  longest_run(v)
}, integer(1))

q3p  <- stats::quantile(ls_run, 0.75, na.rm = TRUE)
iqr  <- stats::IQR(ls_run, na.rm = TRUE)
thr  <- q3p + 1.5 * iqr
flag <- ls_run > thr

dat_attn$longstring_run <- ls_run
dat_attn$exclude_reason <- ifelse(is.na(dat_attn$exclude_reason) & flag, "longstring_outlier",
                           ifelse(!is.na(dat_attn$exclude_reason) & flag,
                                  paste(dat_attn$exclude_reason, "+ longstring_outlier"),
                                  dat_attn$exclude_reason))
dat_final <- dat_attn[!flag, , drop = FALSE]

cat("SurveyWave-aware longstring: threshold >", round(thr, 2),
    "| removed", sum(flag, na.rm = TRUE), "rows.\n")
```

# 5) Resolution covariates (height & area)

```{r resolution, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
# Prefer the filtered dataset
df <- dat_final

# Combined resolution field (very permissive)
res_combined <- names(df)[grepl("resolution", names(df), ignore.case = TRUE)][1] %||% NA_character_

# Separate candidates
res_h_col <- names(df)[grepl("(screen|browser|client|res(olution)?)\\s*.*height", names(df), ignore.case = TRUE)][1] %||% NA_character_
res_w_col <- names(df)[grepl("(screen|browser|client|res(olution)?)\\s*.*width",  names(df), ignore.case = TRUE)][1] %||% NA_character_

df$res_height <- df$res_height %||% NA_real_
df$res_width  <- df$res_width  %||% NA_real_
df$res_area   <- df$res_area   %||% NA_real_

# Parse combined resolution like "1920x1080", "1920 x 1080", "1080 × 1920"
if (!is.na(res_combined)) {
  nums_list <- stringr::str_extract_all(df[[res_combined]], "[0-9]+")
  if (length(nums_list)) {
    first2 <- lapply(nums_list, function(v) as.numeric(v[seq_len(min(2, length(v)))]))
    hw <- t(vapply(first2, function(v) {
      if (length(v) < 2 || anyNA(v)) return(c(h=NA_real_, w=NA_real_))
      c(h = min(v[1], v[2], na.rm = TRUE), w = max(v[1], v[2], na.rm = TRUE))
    }, FUN.VALUE = c(h=NA_real_, w=NA_real_)))
    df$res_height <- ifelse(is.na(df$res_height), hw[, "h"], df$res_height)
    df$res_width  <- ifelse(is.na(df$res_width),  hw[, "w"], df$res_width)
  }
}

# Separate columns if present
if (!is.na(res_h_col)) df$res_height <- ifelse(is.na(df$res_height), suppressWarnings(as.numeric(df[[res_h_col]])), df$res_height)
if (!is.na(res_w_col)) df$res_width  <- ifelse(is.na(df$res_width),  suppressWarnings(as.numeric(df[[res_w_col]])),  df$res_width)

# Area
df$res_area <- ifelse(is.na(df$res_area) & is.finite(df$res_height) & is.finite(df$res_width),
                      df$res_height * df$res_width, df$res_area)

dat_final <- df

summary(dat_final$res_height); summary(dat_final$res_area)
```

# 6) Factors & score

```{r factors-score, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
# Derive/standardize factors
if (!all(c("hierarchy","chartjunk") %in% names(dat_final))) {
  vcol <- intersect(c("version","Version","Condition","condition"), names(dat_final))[1] %||% NA_character_
  if (is.na(vcol)) stop("Need hierarchy/chartjunk or a version column.")
  cj <- stringr::str_match(dat_final[[vcol]], "(High|Medium|Low)Chartjunk$")[,2]
  dat_final$chartjunk <- factor(cj, levels = c("Low","Medium","High"), ordered = TRUE)
  hr <- stringr::str_remove(dat_final[[vcol]], "(High|Medium|Low)Chartjunk$")
  dat_final$hierarchy <- dplyr::recode(hr,
    "NoHierarchy" = "NoHierarchy",
    "FloorplanHierarchy" = "FloorplanHierarchy",
    "RoomHierarchy" = "RoomHierarchy",
    "ImportanceHierarchy" = "ImportanceHierarchy",
    .default = NA_character_
  )
} else {
  dat_final$chartjunk <- factor(dat_final$chartjunk, levels = c("Low","Medium","High"), ordered = TRUE)
  dat_final$hierarchy <- factor(dat_final$hierarchy)
}

# Score: prefer Score/Total_Score; else sum SCn
score_candidates <- c("Score","Total_Score","TotalScore","score")
have <- intersect(score_candidates, names(dat_final))
if (length(have)) {
  dat_final$score <- suppressWarnings(as.numeric(dat_final[[have[1]]]))
} else {
  sc_cols <- grep("^SC\\d+$", names(dat_final), value = TRUE)
  if (length(sc_cols)) {
    dat_final[sc_cols] <- lapply(dat_final[sc_cols], function(x) suppressWarnings(as.numeric(x)))
    dat_final$score <- rowSums(dat_final[sc_cols], na.rm = TRUE)
  } else {
    stop("No score column found (Score/Total_Score or SCn).")
  }
}

datA <- dat_final %>%
  filter(is.finite(score), !is.na(hierarchy), !is.na(chartjunk)) %>%
  droplevels()

datA <- datA %>%
  mutate(
    hierarchy = factor(hierarchy),                           # nominal
    chartjunk = factor(chartjunk, levels = c("Low","Medium","High"), ordered = TRUE)
  ) %>%
  droplevels()


summary(datA$hierarchy); summary(datA$chartjunk)
```

# 7) ANOVA (hierarchy × chartjunk) + sjPlot visuals

```{r anova, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE, fig.width=7, fig.height=4}
m_anova <- lm(score ~ hierarchy * chartjunk, data = datA)

# Table & interaction plot
sjPlot::tab_model(m_anova, show.std = TRUE, show.aic = TRUE, dv.labels = "Score")
sjPlot::plot_model(m_anova, type = "int", terms = c("hierarchy", "chartjunk"))

# Main effects
sjPlot::plot_model(m_anova, type = "pred", terms = "hierarchy")
sjPlot::plot_model(m_anova, type = "pred", terms = "chartjunk")

# Effect sizes
car::Anova(m_anova, type = 2)
effectsize::eta_squared(m_anova, partial = TRUE)
```

# 8) ANCOVA(s) with resolution

```{r ancova, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE, fig.width=7, fig.height=4}
# ==== ANCOVA(s) with resolution (robust to sjPlot naming bug) ====

# Build models list
models <- list()
if ("res_height" %in% names(datA) && any(is.finite(datA$res_height))) {
  models[["Height"]] <- lm(score ~ hierarchy * chartjunk + res_height, data = datA)
}
if ("res_area" %in% names(datA) && any(is.finite(datA$res_area))) {
  models[["Area"]]   <- lm(score ~ hierarchy * chartjunk + res_area,   data = datA)
}

if (length(models) > 0) {
  for (nm in names(models)) {
    m <- models[[nm]]
    cat("\n## ANCOVA with", nm, "covariate\n")
    # sjPlot table
    print(sjPlot::tab_model(m, show.std = TRUE, show.aic = TRUE,
                            dv.labels = paste0("Score (", nm, ")")))
    # Interaction and main-effect plots
    print(sjPlot::plot_model(m, type = "int",  terms = c("hierarchy", "chartjunk")))
    print(sjPlot::plot_model(m, type = "pred", terms = "hierarchy"))
    print(sjPlot::plot_model(m, type = "pred", terms = "chartjunk"))
    # Optional: Type-III partial eta^2
    print(effectsize::eta_squared(car::Anova(m, type = 3), partial = TRUE))
  }
} else {
  message("No usable resolution covariate found; ANCOVA skipped.")
}


```

# 8.5) ANCOVA with prior usage

```{r}
# ---- Libraries & tiny helper --------------------------------------------------
if (!requireNamespace("pacman", quietly = TRUE)) install.packages("pacman")
pacman::p_load(dplyr, stringr, emmeans, broom, tidyr)

`%||%` <- function(a,b) if (is.null(a) || length(a)==0 || all(is.na(a))) b else a

# ---- 0) REQUIRE: dat_final exists --------------------------------------------
stopifnot(exists("dat_final"), is.data.frame(dat_final))

# ---- 1) Derive/standardize factors (your original logic) ---------------------
if (!all(c("hierarchy","chartjunk") %in% names(dat_final))) {
  vcol <- intersect(c("version","Version","Condition","condition"), names(dat_final))[1] %||% NA_character_
  if (is.na(vcol)) stop("Need hierarchy/chartjunk or a version column.")
  cj <- stringr::str_match(dat_final[[vcol]], "(High|Medium|Low)Chartjunk$")[,2]
  dat_final$chartjunk <- factor(cj, levels = c("Low","Medium","High"), ordered = TRUE)
  hr <- stringr::str_remove(dat_final[[vcol]], "(High|Medium|Low)Chartjunk$")
  dat_final$hierarchy <- dplyr::recode(hr,
    "NoHierarchy" = "NoHierarchy",
    "FloorplanHierarchy" = "FloorplanHierarchy",
    "RoomHierarchy" = "RoomHierarchy",
    "ImportanceHierarchy" = "ImportanceHierarchy",
    .default = NA_character_
  )
} else {
  dat_final$chartjunk <- factor(dat_final$chartjunk, levels = c("Low","Medium","High"), ordered = TRUE)
  dat_final$hierarchy <- factor(dat_final$hierarchy)
}

# ---- 2) Locate core columns (score, resolution, prior-use) -------------------
# score column (try common candidates)
score_col <- intersect(c("score","Score","total_score","TotalScore","Total_Score"), names(dat_final))[1] %||% NA_character_
if (is.na(score_col)) stop("Need a score column; tried: score / total_score variants.")

# resolution area: prefer res_area; else compute from width*height if present; else best guess
if (!"res_area" %in% names(dat_final)) {
  if (all(c("res_width","res_height") %in% names(dat_final))) {
    dat_final$res_area <- suppressWarnings(as.numeric(dat_final$res_width) * as.numeric(dat_final$res_height))
  } else {
    cand_area <- grep("area|resolution_area|pixel.*area", names(dat_final), ignore.case = TRUE, value = TRUE)
    if (length(cand_area)) dat_final$res_area <- suppressWarnings(as.numeric(dat_final[[cand_area[1]]]))
  }
}
if (!"res_area" %in% names(dat_final)) stop("Couldn't find or create res_area.")

# smart-home prior use column (exact long header or fuzzy match)
sh_col <- names(dat_final)[grepl("smart\\s*home.*dashboard", names(dat_final), ignore.case = TRUE)][1] %||%
          names(dat_final)[grepl("smart\\s*home.*use", names(dat_final), ignore.case = TRUE)][1] %||% NA_character_
if (is.na(sh_col)) stop("Can't find the smart-home prior-use column (looked for 'smart home ... dashboard').")

# ---- 3) Build analysis frame --------------------------------------------------
A <- dat_final %>%
  mutate(
    score = as.numeric(.data[[score_col]]),
    prior_sh_any = ifelse(.data[[sh_col]] %in% c("Monthly","Weekly","Daily"), 1L, 0L),
    res_area = as.numeric(res_area),
    res_area_z = as.numeric(scale(res_area))
  ) %>%
  filter(!is.na(score), !is.na(hierarchy), !is.na(chartjunk),
         !is.na(res_area_z), !is.na(prior_sh_any))

# Quick sanity prints
cat("\nCounts by chartjunk x prior_sh_any:\n")
print(A %>% count(chartjunk, prior_sh_any) %>% tidyr::complete(chartjunk, prior_sh_any, fill = list(n = 0)))
cat("\nProportion with ANY smart-home prior use:\n")
print(prop.table(table(A$prior_sh_any)))

# ---- 4) Models: base ANCOVA vs + prior use -----------------------------------
m_base  <- lm(score ~ hierarchy*chartjunk + res_area_z, data = A)
m_prior <- lm(score ~ hierarchy*chartjunk + res_area_z + prior_sh_any, data = A)

cat("\nDoes prior_sh_any improve fit?\n")
print(anova(m_base, m_prior))

# ---- 5) EMMs & contrasts (hold covariates at their means) --------------------
emm_base  <- emmeans(m_base,  ~ chartjunk, cov.reduce = mean)
emm_prior <- emmeans(m_prior, ~ chartjunk, cov.reduce = mean)

HM_base  <- contrast(emm_base,  list(HminusM = c(0,-1,1))) %>% summary(infer = TRUE)
HM_prior <- contrast(emm_prior, list(HminusM = c(0,-1,1))) %>% summary(infer = TRUE)

poly_base  <- contrast(emm_base,  "poly") %>% summary(infer = TRUE)
poly_prior <- contrast(emm_prior, "poly") %>% summary(infer = TRUE)

cat("\nAdjusted means (no prior):\n"); print(emm_base)
cat("\nAdjusted means (+ prior):\n"); print(emm_prior)

cat("\nHigh − Medium contrast (no prior):\n"); print(HM_base)
cat("\nHigh − Medium contrast (+ prior):\n"); print(HM_prior)

cat("\nPolynomial trend on chartjunk (no prior):\n"); print(poly_base)
cat("\nPolynomial trend on chartjunk (+ prior):\n"); print(poly_prior)

# ---- 6) (Optional) Show sample-change effect with matched-rows ANOVA ---------
m_anova_matched <- lm(score ~ hierarchy*chartjunk, data = A)
emm_anova_m <- emmeans(m_anova_matched, ~ chartjunk)
HM_anova_m  <- contrast(emm_anova_m, list(HminusM = c(0,-1,1))) %>% summary(infer = TRUE)

cat("\nMatched-rows ANOVA (no covariates) — High − Medium:\n")
print(HM_anova_m)


```

emmeans::contrast(emms, method = "poly")

# 10) Power block

```{r}
# ===== POWER FROM PILOT (Type III + linear trend for chartjunk) =====

# 0) Use your cleaned pilot
dat_pilot <- datA

# 1) Ensure factors and desired order
dat_pilot$chartjunk <- factor(dat_pilot$chartjunk,
                              levels = c("Low","Medium","High"),
                              ordered = TRUE)
dat_pilot$hierarchy <- factor(dat_pilot$hierarchy)

alpha         <- 0.025
target_power  <- 0.80
shrink        <- 0.80      # mild optimism guard
SESOI_d       <- 0.40      # two-level SESOI; for omnibus, f ≈ d/2 ⇒ 0.20
SESOI_f       <- 0.20

# --- Type III setup for reporting (analytical power doesn't depend on this) ---
old_contr <- options("contrasts")
options(contrasts = c("contr.sum","contr.poly"))

fit_add <- lm(score ~ chartjunk + hierarchy, data = dat_pilot)   # additive model
sigma_hat <- sigma(fit_add)
k_vec <- c(nlevels(dat_pilot$chartjunk), nlevels(dat_pilot$hierarchy))  # 3,4
df2_pilot <- nrow(dat_pilot) - (1 + sum(k_vec - 1))  # residual df in additive model

# Quick reportable table if you need it:
# car::Anova(fit_add, type = 3)

# ---------------- Helpers ----------------
marginal_means_ns <- function(dat, dv, fac){
  mm <- aggregate(dat[[dv]], list(dat[[fac]]), mean)
  ns <- aggregate(dat[[dv]], list(dat[[fac]]), length)
  lv <- as.character(mm[[1]])
  list(levels=lv,
       means=setNames(mm[[2]], lv),
       n=setNames(ns[[2]], lv),
       props=setNames(ns[[2]]/sum(ns[[2]]), lv))
}

# Weighted (unequal-n) omnibus ANOVA f^2 for a k-level factor
f2_weighted_from_means <- function(means, props, sigma){
  mu <- sum(props * means)
  sum(props * (means - mu)^2) / sigma^2
}

# 1-df linear-contrast power with unequal n
power_linear_contrast_givenN <- function(deltaL, c, n_vec, df2, alpha){
  se_factor <- sqrt(sum((c^2)/n_vec))     # SE / sigma
  ncp <- (deltaL / se_factor)^2
  Fc <- qf(1 - alpha, 1, df2)
  1 - pf(Fc, 1, df2, ncp = ncp)
}

# Two root-finders for N
solve_N_linear_trend <- function(deltaL, prop_vec, c, alpha, target_power, k_vec, N_max=5000){
  prop_vec <- prop_vec/sum(prop_vec)
  f_needed <- function(N){
    N <- ceiling(N)
    n_vec <- pmax(2, floor(N * prop_vec))
    df2 <- N - (1 + sum(k_vec - 1))
    if (df2 <= 1) return(-target_power)
    power_linear_contrast_givenN(deltaL, c, n_vec, df2, alpha) - target_power
  }
  ceiling(uniroot(f_needed, c(10, N_max))$root)
}

solve_N_anova_omnibus <- function(f2_weighted, df1, alpha, target_power, k_vec, N_max=5000){
  f_needed <- function(N){
    N <- ceiling(N)
    df2 <- N - (1 + sum(k_vec - 1))
    if (df2 <= df1 + 1) return(-target_power)
    ncp <- N * f2_weighted  # λ = N * f_w^2 with weighted f
    Fc <- qf(1 - alpha, df1, df2)
    (1 - pf(Fc, df1, df2, ncp = ncp)) - target_power
  }
  ceiling(uniroot(f_needed, c(10, N_max))$root)
}

# ---------------- Chartjunk: linear trend (−1,0,+1) ----------------
cj <- marginal_means_ns(dat_pilot, "score", "chartjunk")
cj_means <- cj$means[c("Low","Medium","High")]
cj_props <- cj$props[c("Low","Medium","High")]
c_lin <- c(-1, 0, +1)

# Standardized linear contrast from pilot (delta_L = sum(c_i * mean_i) / sigma)
deltaL_hat  <- sum(c_lin * cj_means) / sigma_hat

# Plan to detect at least SESOI d=.40; for −1,0,+1 contrast, |deltaL| == |d(Low vs High)|
deltaL_plan <- max(SESOI_d, shrink * abs(deltaL_hat)) * sign(ifelse(deltaL_hat==0, 1, deltaL_hat))

# Power at pilot N (using actual cell sizes)
pwr_cj_pilot <- power_linear_contrast_givenN(
  deltaL = deltaL_plan,
  c      = c_lin,
  n_vec  = cj$n[c("Low","Medium","High")],
  df2    = df2_pilot,
  alpha  = alpha
)

# Solve N for 80% power at α=.025, preserving pilot proportions
N_cj <- solve_N_linear_trend(
  deltaL       = deltaL_plan,
  prop_vec     = as.numeric(cj_props),
  c            = c_lin,
  alpha        = alpha,
  target_power = target_power,
  k_vec        = k_vec
)

# ---------------- Hierarchy: omnibus main effect (k=4) ----------------
hi <- marginal_means_ns(dat_pilot, "score", "hierarchy")
f2_hat <- f2_weighted_from_means(hi$means, hi$props, sigma_hat)
f_hat  <- sqrt(f2_hat)
f_plan <- max(SESOI_f, shrink * f_hat)
f2_plan <- f_plan^2
df1_hi <- length(hi$levels) - 1

# Power at pilot N for hierarchy omnibus
Fc_hi <- qf(1 - alpha, df1_hi, df2_pilot)
pwr_hi_pilot <- 1 - pf(Fc_hi, df1_hi, df2_pilot, ncp = nrow(dat_pilot) * f2_plan)

# Solve N for hierarchy omnibus
N_hi <- solve_N_anova_omnibus(
  f2_weighted  = f2_plan,
  df1          = df1_hi,
  alpha        = alpha,
  target_power = target_power,
  k_vec        = k_vec
)

# ---------------- Summary ----------------
N_required <- max(N_cj, N_hi)
N_recommended <- ceiling(N_required * 1.12)  # +12% buffer

out <- list(
  RMSE = sigma_hat,
  chartjunk = list(
    means   = cj_means, props = cj_props,
    deltaL_hat = unname(deltaL_hat),
    deltaL_plan = unname(deltaL_plan),
    power_at_pilotN = unname(round(pwr_cj_pilot, 3)),
    N_target = N_cj
  ),
  hierarchy = list(
    means = hi$means, props = hi$props,
    f_hat = round(f_hat, 3),
    f_plan = round(f_plan, 3),
    power_at_pilotN = unname(round(pwr_hi_pilot, 3)),
    N_target = N_hi
  ),
  N_required_max = N_required,
  N_recommended_with_12pct_buffer = N_recommended
)
print(out, max.levels = 2)

# restore contrasts
options(contrasts = old_contr$contrasts)

```

# ---- Per-item accuracy (Q1–Q20): hardcoded key + charts ----

# Be forgiving about whitespace/case
normalize_label <- function(x) {
  x %>%
    as.character() %>%
    stringr::str_replace_all("&amp;", "&") %>%
    stringr::str_replace_all("&apos;|&#39;", "'") %>%
    stringr::str_replace_all("&quot;", "\"") %>%
    stringr::str_squish() %>%
    stringr::str_to_lower()
}

# Map Q1..Q20 to the actual response columns in datA
# --- replace the old pick_col_for_q() with this ---
pick_col_for_q <- function(i, nm) {
  # all candidates that look like this question
  cand <- grep(paste0("^q", i, "(\\b|_)"), nm, ignore.case = TRUE, value = TRUE)
  if (!length(cand)) return(NA_character_)

  # toss known paradata / helper fields
  bad_re <- "(first.?click|last.?click|click|time|duration|page.?submit|display.?order|random|seen|group|_text$|text$)"
  cand <- cand[!grepl(bad_re, cand, ignore.case = TRUE)]

  # prefer the 'plainest' column name (usually the actual response)
  cand <- cand[order(nchar(cand))]
  cand[1] %||% NA_character_
}


q_map <- tibble(
  qid = paste0("Q", 1:20),

) %>% filter(!is.na(col))
